title: [CQ-V10] Changed code architecture rules
description:

Strong profile stays disabled until isolation, evidence and client gates pass. Preserve legacy behavior and existing dirty bytes. Never directly edit .moe. No second revision authority, scheduler, graph database or native memory database.

Dependency aliases (wired by Moe task ids after import): V04, C05.
